integration_issues.impact: Users cannot navigate between dashboard sections without re-authenticating

integration_issues.issue: Login requests failing with net::ERR_ABORTED in browser console
integration_issues.impact: Inconsistent login success - works sometimes but fails others

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix authentication persistence issue - JWT tokens are not being maintained properly in localStorage or session storage, causing users to be redirected to login page on every navigation. The login API calls are also intermittently failing with net::ERR_ABORTED errors. This prevents users from accessing dashboard features, lessons, and sandbox consistently.
